composition.method: Only complete passed engines from two independent isolated runs of the exact same application source and compiled build; no partial failed Firefox proof is promoted.
composition.executionNote: Chromium and WebKit completed in the first run; Firefox completed in a fresh isolated database run with browser process recycling between viewports and before interactions. This is not a claim that one full three-engine invocation exited successfully.
composition.harnessChanges: Validated optional engine filter; Firefox process/context recycling preserves cookies/localStorage/auth, touch/viewport/service-worker settings and collected observations; browser history preferences unchanged. Every live document pageerror remains fatal. Calculator cleanup preserves the original failure.
composition.priorFailureCauseLimit: The previous Firefox process closed during tail interactions. An 8 GiB container limit and cumulative OOM counters were observed, but no counter baseline for that invocation exists; the exact cause is not asserted.
